scope: REQ-001 AC-1 and AC-2 only; actual schema-definition verification and one disposable source-change review. Broader requirement audits and human validation remain separate.

requirement.acceptance: AC-1: Save and reopen a custom type with string, number, boolean and JSON fields. AC-2: Reject unknown schema properties and invalid field values without saving partial changes.

checks: Required and optional definitions for all four kinds; false/zero/null/nested JSON preserved.
Schema/entity values and complete export are equal after closing/reopening SQLite.
Production Model page authors all four required kinds and an optional field; saves/reloads at 1440px and 390px.
implementation: ui/schema-definition-form.tsx and ui/schema-fields.tsx: configured field authoring

checks: Reject root/type/field schema typos with no saved native/evidence/history differences.
Reject wrong primitive kinds, NaN, unknown fields and missing required values on create and update.
A valid first operation followed by an invalid second operation rolls back the whole batch.
Production editor retains an unsupported-property proposal and blocks invalid saving without changing the project.
implementation: src/application/service.ts: schema validation and changeset transaction

browser.command: npm run build && npx playwright test test/requirement-schema-browser.spec.ts test/model-page-browser.spec.ts
browser.followUp: Rebuilt documentation and reran the two criterion journeys: 2 passed.

execution.changes: Two criterion-focused regression files and documentation/register changes; no runtime source changes.

referenceAdoption.preservation: All existing entity IDs/types/fields, relationships, historical snapshots and immutable evidence preserved; exact legacy file owners can gain resource capability without replacement.
referenceAdoption.meaning: Definition passages, implementation locators and check procedures are contextual uses; component responsibility and requirement-to-plan domain traces remain distinct. References alone do not claim an executed pass.

changeReview.scope: Actual technical result with a controlled source-change fixture. Agent copy taken before the scripted review; no live requirement source or result changed.

modelingFindings.finding: Broad historical source summary did not identify the exact definition paragraphs used for this criterion audit.
modelingFindings.resolution: Kept the original source claim and added two distinct pinned definition uses of one shared architecture resource.

modelingFindings.finding: The register had no configured family for the new reference capability.
modelingFindings.resolution: Rehearsed and added a scoped project family; no new engineering record type or automatic historical consolidation.

modelingFindings.finding: Architecture/developer prose retained contract-1/initial-feature wording after contract 2 shipped.
modelingFindings.resolution: Corrected the owning current interface descriptions; prior result snapshots remain immutable and may report document drift.

limits: This verifies only REQ-001 AC-1/AC-2 for the captured candidate.
No standards conformity or representative-human validation is established.
Fresh-agent UI inspection is recorded separately; agent timings/tool assistance are not human task evidence.
External bytes are not retained by resource observations; selectors are preserved but passage matching/relevance remains unknown.
The source-change exercise and review used disposable copies; the live definition file was not altered to simulate a change.
A first fixture-report attempt omitted a required artifact revision field and was correctly rejected; it was corrected in a new disposable copy.
